payload.instruction: Make this look like a comic book photo
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Does the edited image visibly have comic-book styling?
node.criteria: Pass if comic-book visual styling is visibly present; fail if there is no visible comic-book styling; unknown if the image evidence is insufficient to determine this.
node.binding: Assess the overall visual treatment of the supplied image as edited, without requiring a particular technique.
